name: us032-origin-case-fold
description: 032 C1.3: a designator host containing U+0130. The two ports' native case folds disagreed on it — bash ${x,,} yielded "istanbul.x" where .NET ToLowerInvariant() yielded "İstanbul.x" — so a host is now folded by an explicitly enumerated ASCII mapping in both. A host reaching this comparison is attacker-supplied. Locks the repair.
